title: Xanthe and the Cellar
author: Casper Sandoval
blurb: Ulyana Eastwick, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
